data.text: John, Kate, Jack, Emma—I’m making my position clear before we fish: I will request 100 tons this month, regardless of anyone else’s restraint. I will not honor a 10-ton agreement. With 100 tons in the lake, your restraint cannot preserve the stock if my request takes the entire lake. Each of you should choose at least 25 tons now so you have a chance to capture fish rather than leave them for me. Coordinate that defensive response among yourselves, and encourage one another to do likewise. John, will you ask Kate, Jack, and Emma to join you in requesting at least 25 tons each?
